[[File:Mr Vazir Sultan.jpg|thumb]]'''VST Industries Ltd''' is an Indian [[Public company|publicly-listed]] company which manufactures and distributes cigarettes.<ref>{{cite web |title=VST Industries – Brands |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-facts/vstindustries/products/VST |access-date=30 December 2025 |publisher=Moneycontrol}}</ref> The company is headquartered in [[Hyderabad]].

VST Industries started off as the '''Vazir Sultan Tobacco Company''', and became an affiliate undertaking of [[British American Tobacco]] group of the [[United Kingdom]].<ref>{{cite news |date=25 April 2024 |title=VST Industries launches new variants to boost premium portfolio |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/vst-industries-launches-new-cigarette-variants-124042500736_1.html |access-date=30 December 2025 |publisher=Business Standard}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |date=25 April 2025 |title=VST Industries Q4 profit falls 42%; declares ₹10 dividend |url=https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/vst-industries-q4-profit-falls-42-declares-rs-10-dividend-125042500729_1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250426085134/https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/vst-industries-q4-profit-falls-42-declares-rs-10-dividend-125042500729_1.html |archive-date=26 April 2025 |access-date=30 December 2025 |publisher=Business Standard}}</ref> It became fully independent and registered as VST Industries Ltd in 1983.<ref>{{cite report |title=CRISIL Ratings – VST Industries Limited |date=14 May 2025 |publisher=CRISIL}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Shareholding Pattern – VST Industries |url=https://www.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/vst-industries-ltd/vstindustries/509966/shareholding-pattern/ |access-date=30 December 2025 |publisher=BSE India}}</ref> British American Tobacco, through its subsidiaries, owns a 32.16% stake in the company.

== History ==
The company was incorporated on 10 November 1930 as the '''Vazir Sultan Tobacco Company Limited''' under the Hyderabad Companies Act No. IV of 1320 Fasli.<ref name="hist1">{{cite web |title=Company History |url=https://www.vsthyd.com/mainsite/about-us.html |publisher=VST Industries |access-date=6 January 2026}}</ref> In April 1983, it was renamed '''VST Industries Limited'''.<ref name="hist1"/> Over the decades, the company established a presence in the Indian cigarette manufacturing industry with a portfolio of regional and national brands.<ref>{{cite report |title=CRISIL Rating Rationale – VST Industries Limited |publisher=CRISIL |date=14 May 2025 |url=https://www.crisil.com/mnt/winshare/Ratings/RatingList/RatingDocs/VSTIndustriesLimited_May_14_2025_RR_368319.html |access-date=6 January 2026}}</ref>

== Tobacco leaf operations ==
VST Industries is also engaged in the trading and processing of unmanufactured tobacco. According to the company, tobacco leaf procurement and processing form a key component of its operations, supporting both domestic cigarette manufacturing and exports to international markets.<ref>{{cite report |title=Annual Report 2024–25 |publisher=VST Industries |url=https://www.vsthyd.com/mainsite/documents/annual_report_2025.pdf |access-date=6 January 2026}}</ref>

The company states that it works with a large network of contracted farmers across tobacco-growing regions in southern India and has developed specialised tobacco varieties, including Indian Oriental tobacco and Dark Fire Cured tobacco, for use in domestic and export markets.<ref name=":0">{{Cite news |last=Moneycontrol.com |title=VST Industries > Company History > Cigarettes > Company History of VST Industries - BSE: 509966, NSE: VSTIND |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-facts/vstindustries/history/VST |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231006081023/https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-facts/vstindustries/history/VST |archive-date=2023-10-06 |access-date=2026-01-05 |language=en}}</ref> VST reports that its tobacco leaf business achieved a turnover of ₹472 crore in FY 2024–25, representing year-on-year growth.<ref name=":0" />

== Operations ==
VST Industries’ principal business activities include the manufacture and trading of cigarettes and unmanufactured tobacco.<ref>{{cite web |title=Company Profile |url=https://www.crisil.com/mnt/winshare/Ratings/RatingList/RatingDocs/VSTIndustriesLimited_May_14_2025_RR_368319.html |publisher=CRISIL |access-date=6 January 2026}}</ref> The company operates manufacturing facilities at Azamabad, Hyderabad, and Toopran in Telangana. The Toopran facility, which integrates primary and secondary manufacturing divisions, became fully operational during FY 2024–25.<ref name=":0" />

According to the company, VST distributes its products through a nationwide network of wholesale dealers and retail outlets and maintains regional offices in major Indian cities. Unmanufactured tobacco is also exported to overseas markets.<ref name=":0"/>

== Products and brands ==
VST Industries markets a portfolio of cigarette brands across different segments. Its brands include Total, Editions, Charms, Moments and Special.<ref>{{cite web |title=VST Industries – Brand Portfolio |url=https://www.reuters.com/companies/VSTI.NS |publisher=Reuters |access-date=6 January 2026}}</ref> In FY 2024–25, the company introduced new variants such as Editions Trio, Total Spin and Total Paan Delight.<ref>{{cite news |title=VST Industries launches new cigarette variants |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/vst-industries-launches-new-cigarette-variants-124042500736_1.html |publisher=Business Standard |date=25 April 2024 |access-date=6 January 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250426084316/https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/vst-industries-launches-new-cigarette-variants-124042500736_1.html |archive-date=26 April 2025}}</ref>

== Financial performance ==
For the financial year ending 31 March 2025, VST Industries reported revenue from operations of ₹1,80,943 [[lakh]] and a net profit of ₹29,039 lakh.<ref name=":0"/> The board recommended a dividend of ₹10 per share for FY 2024–25.<ref>{{cite news |title=VST Industries Q4 profit falls 42%; declares ₹10 dividend |url=https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/vst-industries-q4-profit-falls-42-declares-rs-10-dividend-125042500729_1.html |publisher=Business Standard |date=25 April 2025 |access-date=6 January 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250426085134/https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/vst-industries-q4-profit-falls-42-declares-rs-10-dividend-125042500729_1.html |archive-date=26 April 2025}}</ref>

== Corporate social responsibility and ESG ==
VST Industries publishes an annual ESG report outlining its environmental, social and governance initiatives.<ref>{{cite report |title=ESG Report 2023–24 |publisher=VST Industries |url=https://www.vsthyd.com/mainsite/documents/esg_report_2023-24.pdf |access-date=6 January 2026}}</ref> According to the company, its CSR activities include programmes in healthcare, education, rural development and environmental sustainability. The company reported CSR expenditure of ₹844 lakh during FY 2024–25.<ref name=":0"/>

== Governance ==
The company is governed by a board comprising executive, non-executive and independent directors. As of April 2025, Naresh Kumar Sethi serves as chairman of the board, and Piyush Srivastava as managing director and chief executive officer.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Desk |first=Prysm Editorial |date=2026-01-29 |title=VST Industries Appoints Piyush Srivastava as MD & CEO; Recommends New Auditors {{!}} VST Industries Limited (VSTIND) {{!}} Prysm |url=https://prysm.fi/news/vst-industries-appoints-piyush-srivastava-as-md-ceo-recommends-new-auditors |access-date=2026-03-28 |website=Prysm Finance |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-02-01 |title=Piyush Srivastava Appointed Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer at VST Industries Limited - Global HR News & Updates |url=https://hrtoday.in/piyush-srivastava-appointed-managing-director-chief-executive-officer-at-vst-industries-limited/ |access-date=2026-03-28 |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Shareholding ==
British American Tobacco Plc is the principal promoter of VST Industries and held approximately 32.16% of the company’s equity as of 2025.<ref>{{cite web |title=Shareholding Pattern |url=https://www.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/vst-industries-ltd/vstindustries/509966/shareholding-pattern/ |publisher=BSE India |access-date=6 January 2026}}</ref> Other shareholders include institutional investors and public shareholders, including Bright Star Investments Private Limited.<ref>{{cite web |title=Major Shareholders – VST Industries |url=https://in.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/VST-INDUSTRIES-LIMITED-7591901/company-shareholders/ |publisher=MarketScreener |access-date=6 January 2026}}</ref>
